-- Untrusted names: true only for a single plain file name, with no
-- separators and no dot segments, so it cannot leave the notes directory.
is_safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == (name != "" and name != "." and name != ".." and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1)
  ex is_safe_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_safe_name("../secret") == False
  name != "" and name != "." and name != ".." and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1

-- Contents of notes/name, or "" when the name is unsafe, missing, or unreadable.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post is_safe_name(name) or out == ""
  ex read_note("missing-file-xyz") == ""
  ex read_note("../secret") == ""
  if not is_safe_name(name)
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return ""
    return text
  ""

-- True only when notes/name exists and can be read.
is_readable(name: str) -> bool uses fs =
  ex is_readable("missing-file-xyz") == False
  ex is_readable("../secret") == False
  if not is_safe_name(name)
    return False
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return False
    return True
  False

-- Number of names that are readable files inside notes.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  ex count_readable(["missing-file-xyz", "../secret"]) == 0
  var n = 0
  for name in names
    if is_readable(name)
      n += 1
  n
